Name: Twitchpoint
Description: Shows Twitchpoint drop progress, ETA and priority queue on your Stream Deck.

com.twitchpoint.streamdeck.watching.Name: Watching
com.twitchpoint.streamdeck.watching.Tooltip: Channel Twitchpoint is watching right now. Press to refresh.

com.twitchpoint.streamdeck.drop-progress.Name: Drop Progress
com.twitchpoint.streamdeck.drop-progress.Tooltip: Minutes on the drop being farmed, e.g. 56/120. Press to refresh.

com.twitchpoint.streamdeck.drop-position.Name: Drop Position
com.twitchpoint.streamdeck.drop-position.Tooltip: Which drop of the campaign this is, e.g. 4/5. Press to refresh.

com.twitchpoint.streamdeck.next-drop.Name: Next Drop
com.twitchpoint.streamdeck.next-drop.Tooltip: The drop you get after the current one. Press to refresh.

com.twitchpoint.streamdeck.campaign-eta.Name: Campaign ETA
com.twitchpoint.streamdeck.campaign-eta.Tooltip: Watch time until every drop in the campaign is earned. Press to refresh.

com.twitchpoint.streamdeck.next-game.Name: Next Game
com.twitchpoint.streamdeck.next-game.Tooltip: Next game with a running campaign, in your priority order. Press to refresh.
